basic_info.description: 405 2nd Ave is a well-maintained three-story mixed-use building located in San Francisco's desirable Inner Richmond neighborhood, known for its strong community character and cultural diversity. Just steps from neighborhood parks, local shops, and public transit, the property offers excellent access to Golden Gate Park, the vibrant Clement Street commercial corridor, and is only minutes from UCSF, Geary Boulevard transit lines, and other key city destinations.  The building spans 6,168 square feet on a 3,250-square-foot lot and features a ground-floor commercial space, four two-bedroom, one-bathroom apartments, and four garage parking spaces. All units are currently rented, generating consistent and reliable income. The property is zoned Neighborhood Commercial (NC-3), and its Assessor's Parcel Number (APN) is 1542-001.  This offering presents a rare opportunity for investors to acquire a stable, income-generating asset in one of San Francisco's most vibrant and centrally located neighborhoods.    All offers are due by 12:00 PM (noon) on Wednesday, July 30, 2025 and should be submitted to Ning.Ho@MarcusMillichap.com.    Contact listing agent for showing: Ning.Ho@MarcusMillichap.com.
